articles.title: Qualcomm plots out 6G, Wi-Fi 8 future with AI as the new user interface
articles.summary: Qualcomm, a communications technology provider, is detailing its strategic vision for how Artificial Intelligence (AI) will transform the connectivity market. They foresee an 'agentic-oriented business world' emerging, driven by AI's capabilities. Qualcomm's plans focus on adapting its technology to align with this future landscape, emphasizing the profound impact of AI on evolving communication and business models. This highlights a key industry shift.

articles.title: ‘Flying Is A Very Large Part’ of Final Fantasy VII Remake Part 3, But The Status of Chocobo Breeding And Underwater Exploration Is Unclear
articles.summary: Game director Naoki Hamaguchi confirmed in a Bloomberg interview that the iconic Highwind airship will be a significant and highly anticipated feature in Final Fantasy VII Remake Part 3. This integration is expected to be a major highlight, allowing players to explore the game world in a new and engaging way. The airship promises to enhance traversal and add considerable depth to the expansive gaming experience.

articles.title: Turkey deploys six F-16 fighter jets, air defence systems to northern Cyprus
articles.summary: Turkey has deployed six F-16 fighter jets and air defence systems to northern Cyprus to bolster the security of the Turkish community. Announced by its defence ministry, this move signifies a significant military reinforcement in the region. It aims to enhance strategic presence and readiness amidst ongoing tensions in the Eastern Mediterranean and the unresolved Cyprus dispute, with further measures anticipated from Turkey.

articles.title: Arunachal Pradesh town turns into a colourful field of flowers in April-May. Even Anand Mahindra suggests it for summer travel
articles.summary: Arunachal Pradesh, known as the 'Land of the Dawn-lit Mountains,' is highlighted as an ideal summer travel destination within India. The article encourages booking a trip to this scenic northeastern state, emphasizing its unique beauty and charm for those seeking a domestic escapade. It showcases the region's appeal for tourism, inviting aspirants to explore its natural and cultural richness.

articles.title: Belagavi startup vs global AI giant: Karnataka court orders summons to Anthropic’s US headquarters in Rs 1 crore trademark suit
articles.summary: Belagavi-based Anthropic Software Private Limited has accused a US company of deliberate use of a deceptively similar mark. This legal dispute alleges 'passing off' and 'unfair competition,' causing consumer confusion. The Indian software firm is seeking legal redress against the foreign entity over intellectual property infringement and unethical business practices in the technology sector.

articles.title: Iran sought permission for docking of 3 ships in Indian ports; approval granted: Jaishankar
articles.summary: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar confirmed India swiftly granted Iran permission for three of its ships to dock at Indian ports. This approval, given the day after Iran's request, underscores India's active diplomatic engagement and willingness to facilitate international maritime movements. Such swift decisions reflect India's foreign policy approach and its role in regional dynamics, crucial aspects for SSB aspirants to understand.

articles.title: Fantasy Basketball Schedule Guide: Top Streaming Plays & Teams This Week
articles.summary: The fantasy basketball postseason emphasizes strategic game management for success, with Week 21 offering significant scheduling advantages. Aspirants must maximize games played to achieve a championship run and avoid early elimination. Careful planning around player schedules is critical for navigating the intense playoff structure in this competitive digital league.
